units: USD millions except share prices, actual share counts and multiples

methodology.earnings: GAAP operating income, FY plus current YTD minus prior YTD. SBC and all other reported operating costs retained. Separate intangible-amortization-only sensitivity is not company adjusted EBIT or EBITDA.
methodology.capital: Price times dated actual shares (not weighted-average shares), plus financial debt principal and finance leases, less unrestricted cash. Operating leases excluded from EV and their expense retained in EBIT. No netting of restricted cash.
methodology.qualification: PFGC September principal debt unavailable from release, so exact principal EV null; separately label carrying-value proxy. USFD uses June capital and July shares, with October refinancing disclosed. No synchronized current EV or price target.
